Leave-one-out cross-validation for linear models

Source: R/qr-downdate.R
lm_loo_cv.Rd

Computes exact leave-one-out (LOO) prediction errors from a single QR factorization, using the identity \(e_{(i)} = e_i / (1 - h_{ii})\) where \(e_i\) are the ordinary residuals and \(h_{ii}\) the leverages. The result is identical to refitting the model n times with one observation dropped each time. X must have full column rank.

Usage

lm_loo_cv(X, y, method = "qr", ...)

Arguments

X

Numeric matrix or adgeMatrix of predictors, shape [n, p]. No intercept column is added automatically.

y

Numeric vector or single-column matrix of responses, length n.

method

Retained for compatibility; only "qr" is supported.

...

Additional arguments forwarded to qr.

Value

A named list with two elements:

residuals

Numeric vector of length n: LOO prediction errors \(y_i - \hat{y}_i^{(-i)}\).

mse

Scalar mean squared LOO error.

See also

lm_fit, many_lm

Examples

X <- adgeMatrix(matrix(rnorm(50), nrow = 10))
y <- rnorm(10)
cv <- lm_loo_cv(X, y)
cv$mse
#> [1] 0.9893432
